in_hebrew.name: Ettari
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Ettari הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'ettos', meaning 'eighth'. In biblical context, it may symbolize the eighth day of creation, a day of rest and renewal.

in_greek.long_meaning: Ettari είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek word 'ettos', meaning 'eighth'. In biblical context, it may symbolize the eighth day of creation, a day of rest and renewal.

in_latin.name: Ettari
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Eternal, Enduring
